description: This file defines a custom HTML element 'cc-autocomplete' that provides autocomplete functionality, including rendering options, handling user input, fetching suggestions from a server endpoint, and managing UI interactions.

classes.name: Autocomplete
classes.description: A custom HTML element that provides autocomplete functionality with dynamic suggestions fetched from a server endpoint.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the autocomplete element, sets up DOM structure, event listeners, and default configurations.

methods.name: setupEndpoint
methods.description: Configures the server endpoint for fetching autocomplete suggestions based on element attributes.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input value and display text for the autocomplete component.

methods.name: removeActive
methods.description: Removes the 'active' class from a list of option elements.

methods.name: addActive
methods.description: Adds the 'active' class to a specific option in the list based on current focus.

methods.name: createOption
methods.description: Creates a suggestion option element and appends it to the options list.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Positions the suggestion dropdown relative to the input element, adjusting for viewport space.
